_comment: Machine-readable manifest for base composition #3. Generated 2026-05-15 from `drive/Описание лонгрида - порядок базовых слоев.csv` (rows where id_layer_base=3). This is the default basemap for chapter 2 *«Горы Петербурга»* (sections 10–13). The CSV intent for the raster row is `multiply, opacity 40%` — MapLibre GL JS has no `mix-blend-mode: multiply` for raster layers, so this manifest emits the plain `relief` pyramid at `opacity: 0.4` (no pre-bake needed; base #3 has no hillshade companion to fuse with). Vector style definitions duplicate the ones in `base-composition-1.json` verbatim — they share the same `name_vector_style` in the CSV (sectors_level, isoline_5m, stage, water), so values must stay in lockstep. See `README-base-composition-3.md`.

render_order.name: relief
render_order.note: Plain relief pyramid — not relief_hillshade. Already deployed at `https://pashteto.github.io/gavr-tiles/relief/{z}/{x}/{y}.png` and `amphitheater.pashteto.com/tiles/relief/{z}/{x}/{y}.png` (the Phase-2 pyramid; never retired). CSV's `multiply, opacity 40%` cannot be expressed directly (MapLibre lacks multiply blend on raster), so we approximate the near-grayscale look the chapter-2 Frames 46–49 call for by combining raster-opacity, heavy desaturation, and a slight brightness lift. Starting values; tune by eye against the frames. See plan/08-base-3-tuning.md.

render_order.name: isoline_5m
render_order.note: Same simplified 25 m-tolerance bundle (3.5 MB, 1843 features) used by base #1; nothing new to bundle.

calibration_note: Vector styles inherit base #1's already-tuned opacities (sectors_level 0.01, stage 0.05, water 0.05). The only fresh calibration knob is raster `opacity`: 0.4 is a literal port of the CSV value but the design intent was `multiply, opacity 40%`. Multiply darkens through the relief; plain-opacity at 0.4 lightens it. If chapter 2 reads too washed-out, raise to 0.55–0.7 to recover contrast — visual-only call, no code change needed.
